name: How long does it take to get a home value estimate?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to get a home value estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeframe for receiving a home value estimate can vary. An initial conversation might take 15-30 minutes, followed by a property visit that typically lasts 30-60 minutes depending on the home's size and complexity. After the visit, a comprehensive comparative market analysis (CMA) usually takes 1-3 business days to compile, as the agent meticulously researches recent sales and market data specific to your area, such as Midtown/Wynwood or Coral Gables. Providing access to all relevant property details beforehand can expedite this process.
acceptedAnswer.description: An estimate typically takes a few days, including a property visit and the time needed for the agent to complete a detailed comparative market analysis.
